nodes.label: 2026-07-02 Herdr Self-Kill Incident
nodes.rationale: A bare `herdr server stop` command during cleanup killed the captain's live default herdr server because HERDR_SESSION-based targeting is not reliably honored once another herdr server is running. Fixed by: (1) created-vs-adopted workspace gate ensures container_ensure never prunes a pre-existing workspace's default tab, (2) all herdr lifecycle operations route through herdr_safe_stop_and_delete and fm-herdr-lab.sh, (3) never use bare/ambient `herdr server stop`.

nodes.label: 2026-07-03 Herdr Respawn Husk Incident
nodes.rationale: After a herdr server restart, restored fm-<id> task tabs came back as dead-pane husks (plain agent-less shells in the saved cwd). Before the fix, fm_backend_herdr_create_task refused to spawn into a same-labeled tab unconditionally, requiring manual pane close. Fixed by: close-and-replace dead/agent-less husks, but still refuse when a genuinely live registered agent is present.

nodes.label: 2026-07-07 Composer Submit Incident
nodes.rationale: Composer submit confirmation was unreliable when using composer text content alone. The popup-placeholder regression: a slash-command popup's argument-hint text was read as 'pending' after Enter closed the popup, so a second Enter was required. Fixed by: using native agent-state (agent get) for submit confirmation instead of composer content, and treating popup-close with placeholder fill as pending so the caller retries.

nodes.label: 2026-07-14 Two-Owner Incident
nodes.rationale: An away-mode blocked event survived in durable state, but the ordinary return request could proceed to Bearings before Firstmate owned remediation. Fixed by: return catch-up gate (fm-afk-return.sh) that stops, drains, preserves evidence, and refuses ordinary work until every live open blocked event is resolved or durably reclassified. A captain-owned needs-decision event is NOT treated as a firstmate blocker.

nodes.label: AFK Daemon Injection Contract
nodes.rationale: Three injection scenarios: (A) human-partial-input defers and delivers clean digest after idle, (B) swallowed-Enter retries Enter (not digest) and delivers exactly one clean submission, (C) normal status delivers exactly one sentinel-prefixed single-line digest. Uses U+2063 INVISIBLE SEPARATOR as terminal-safe sentinel marker. All assertions on submitted CONTENT, not pane appearance. The herdr counterpart also tests (D) max-defer alarm: a persistently non-clearing composer writes .subsuper-inject-wedged while preserving the buffered escalation.

nodes.label: AFK Launch Topology Contract
nodes.rationale: Entering AND exiting away mode must leave the captain's active tab topology UNCHANGED. The daemon lands in a NON-VISIBLE separate terminal (herdr dedicated workspace or detached tmux session), never a split of the captain's pane. Covers stale-artifact lifecycle: fresh entry clears artifacts, refresh preserves current session's buffered escalations, correct-ordered stop (daemon SIGTERM'd while .afk present, .afk cleared last).

nodes.label: PreToolUse Seatbelt Security Pattern
nodes.rationale: A shared command-policy checker (fm-arm-pretool-check.sh + fm-arm-command-policy.mjs) is wired into ALL five harnesses (Claude, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, Grok) through harness-specific hooks/plugins. Checks watcher-arm commands before execution. Five harness entry forms tested: plain binary path, exec, cd+exec, export+command, source+command. Background flag accepted as non-gating. Fails CLOSED on harness-specific shape: Grok gets JSON deny payload on stderr, others get empty stdout.

nodes.label: Herdr Native Event Subscription Escalation
nodes.rationale: Native pane.agent_status_changed push escalation via raw-socket reader (herdr-eventwait.py) that subscribes to events.subscribe protocol and returns sub-second on idle->blocked transitions. The watcher's handle_push_transition enqueues a stale wake in the wake queue without waiting for the ~240s wedge timer. Replaces the slow poll-based stale-pane detection for herdr.

nodes.label: Workspace-Per-Home Isolation Pattern
nodes.rationale: Each FM_HOME (primary domain and each secondmate) gets its own herdr workspace labeled with the home name. Primary spawns land in the 'firstmate' workspace, secondmate spawns land in the '2ndmate-<name>' workspace, and crewmates spawned FROM a secondmate home also land in the secondmate's workspace. Teardown only closes the task's own tab within its home workspace. list_live recovery sees only its own home's tabs. This falls out of per-home workspace label resolution (fm_backend_herdr_workspace_find), no glue logic needed.

nodes.label: Runtime Backend Auto-Detection
nodes.rationale: bin/fm-backend.sh's fm_backend_detect wires into fm_backend_name between config/backend and the tmux default. Auto-detection is a fm-spawn-TIME decision, proven by running REAL fm-spawn.sh end to end. Detects herdr from HERDR_ENV=1, prints a loud EXPERIMENTAL notice on stderr. The nested case (tmux inside herdr resolves to tmux silently) is exercised separately with fake-tmux fm-spawn tests.

nodes.label: Old-vs-New Backend Refactoring Conformance
nodes.rationale: The P1 runtime-backend extraction moved tmux command sequences from fm-send.sh, fm-peek.sh, fm-spawn.sh, and fm-teardown.sh into named adapter functions in bin/backends/tmux.sh. Refactored scripts are proven byte-identical to the pre-refactor originals by running both against the SAME fake tmux/treehouse binaries and fixtures and diffing command logs. Uses merge-base checkouts for the pre-refactor originals.

nodes.label: Parallel Backend Adapter Structure
nodes.rationale: Each terminal backend (tmux, herdr, zellij, cmux, orca) has three test layers: (1) fake-CLI unit tests with canned responses and command-log assertion, (2) real-binary smoke tests on isolated/private sessions, (3) full E2E through fm-spawn.sh/fm-teardown.sh. Safety isolation techniques vary by backend capabilities: tmux uses private socket (-L), herdr uses named --session with fm-herdr-lab.sh, zellij uses FM_ZELLIJ_SESSION, cmux uses fm-test- prefix labels with guarded close.

nodes.label: Cmux Unique Safety Concerns
nodes.rationale: cmux has no isolated throwaway SESSION - there is just one shared GUI-first macOS-only instance. Safety rules: never close a workspace the test did not create, never enumerate-and-close, fail CLOSED on ambiguity. The guard checks workspace_id is non-empty, label has fm-test- prefix, and the workspace's CURRENT title matches the scoped expected title. kill is whole-workspace close (never bulk/enumerate). business_state always 'unknown' (no native agent-state primitive).

nodes.label: Backlog Handoff Contract
nodes.rationale: Multi-line body moves byte-exact, nothing orphans in the source, and re-running is a no-op. The move is delegated to tasks-axi mv, so this suite exercises the real binary.

nodes.label: Composer Shell Glyph Safety
nodes.rationale: A bare shell prompt glyph (>/$/%/#) on an unstructured row is a dead shell, NOT an empty agent composer - it must read unknown (unsafe-for-injection), never empty.

nodes.label: Ghost Text Robustness
nodes.rationale: A harness fills an otherwise-empty composer with de-emphasised ghost text that a plain pane capture cannot tell apart from human input. Two rendering styles (DIM/FAINT and dark TRUECOLOR) are covered by one shared ANSI-aware owner.

nodes.label: Crew State Authoritative Source
nodes.rationale: The status file (state/<id>.status) is a best-effort append-only EVENT LOG. fm-crew-state reads the AUTHORITATIVE source (a matching no-mistakes run-step, else the pane busy-signature) and reconciles the stale log.

nodes.label: Gate Refuse Capability Removal
nodes.rationale: fm-gate-refuse-lib.sh fails closed on two independent signals: NO_MISTAKES_GATE env marker or git-common-dir resolving under .no-mistakes/repos/*.git (unspoofable backstop).

nodes.label: Lint Parity Guard
nodes.rationale: fm-lint.sh must be the single owner that BOTH CI and the pre-push gate invoke, so local lint never diverges from CI. Pins ShellCheck 0.11.0 to avoid version-skew regressions.

nodes.label: Supervise Daemon Framework
nodes.rationale: Supervise-daemon provides captain-relevant status-phrase classifiers, escalation batching/dedupe, afk presence-gating, and injection-hardening units.

nodes.label: Fleet Sync Drift Handling
nodes.rationale: Clean detached HEAD that holds no unique commits is re-attached and fast-forwarded. Every other off-default state is reported as a loud STUCK warning.

nodes.label: Decision Hold Lifecycle
nodes.rationale: Durable captain-held decisions discovered by investigations and visual reviews must survive teardown. Completion refuses before teardown can erase an uninventoried unresolved decision.

nodes.label: Herdr Lab Safety
nodes.rationale: Herdr labs require ownership tripwires to prevent destructively cleaning another session's lab. Provision validates session names; teardown verifies fleet state unchanged.

nodes.label: cd-guard Design
nodes.rationale: The cd-guard PreToolUse seatbelt scopes to real primary checkout, drives all five harness entry forms. Inert in child worktrees and non-firstmate repos.

nodes.label: Grok Hook Security
nodes.rationale: Grok global hook requires a firstmate registry token. Token must be on first line; target path not exposed in pointer file. Teardown removes pointer, token state.

nodes.label: GOTMPDIR Integration
nodes.rationale: fm-spawn creates task temp root /tmp/fm-<id>/ with gotmp/ for Go builds, exports GOTMPDIR, records tasktmp= in meta. fm-teardown removes the root on cleanup.

nodes.label: Stale Banner Deduplication
nodes.rationale: First stale command per FM_HOME prints full watcher banner. Repeated calls in same episode print concise reminder. Healthy recovery re-arms next episode.

nodes.label: Quota-Balanced Dispatch
nodes.rationale: Quota-balanced picks candidate with higher general-window minimum. Exact ties use first profile. Missing/errored quota-axi falls back to first. Stale cached quota needs clear margin.

nodes.label: Captain Translation Contract
nodes.rationale: Every captain-facing message must translate internal state into project outcome and consequence. Internal labels (worktree, teardown, wake, harness) rewritten to plain English (local copy, cleanup, notification, tool).

nodes.label: Validate Contract
nodes.rationale: The AGENTS.md Validate section contract that specifies ownership of no-mistakes pipeline calls. Task worker drives the pipeline; firstmate never invokes axi respond for crew-owned runs.

nodes.label: Worker Owns Synchronous Driver
nodes.rationale: The task worker that starts a no-mistakes run drives the entire pipeline, owning every no-mistakes axi run and axi respond call through the next gate or outcome.

nodes.label: Firstmate Respond Restriction
nodes.rationale: Firstmate never invokes no-mistakes axi respond for a crew-owned run. Ensures proper ownership boundaries.

nodes.label: Pi Watcher Extension Fire
nodes.rationale: Pi primary extension integration: watcher tool fires, arm child respawns, guard injection and cleanup on exit. End-to-end test for Pi as primary harness.

nodes.label: Strict No-Emit Typecheck
nodes.rationale: Both tracked Pi primary extensions must pass strict no-emit TypeScript type checking against the installed Pi package. Validates type compatibility without emitting compiled output.

nodes.label: Pi Watch Extension Self-Hashing
nodes.rationale: The fm-primary-pi-watch.ts extension self-hashes its own content via createHash('sha256') for content-addressed extensionVersion. Self-locates via fileURLToPath(import.meta.url).

nodes.label: Session Lock Ownership Check
nodes.rationale: The Pi watch extension checks session lock ownership with three states: owned, missing, other. Refuses to arm without the session lock (returns ok:false for other sessions).

nodes.label: External Healthy Watcher Detection
nodes.rationale: Watch extension detects and reports external healthy watchers so the turn-end guard still triggers even when another watcher is already running. Does not double-stack watch arms.

nodes.label: Canonical PR Parsing
nodes.rationale: Canonical parsing of PR URLs into owner/repo/number for secure gh-axi usage. Part of the security and regression test matrix for PR check, merge poll, and migration.

nodes.label: Static PR Merge Poll
nodes.rationale: Byte-static PR merge poll artifacts with private atomic publication and validation. Non-executing migration replaces legacy executable checks with validated static polls.

nodes.label: Private Atomic Artifacts
nodes.rationale: Three private artifact types: check.sh (mode 0700), pr-poll (sidecar data), pr-poll-registration (transactional provenance). Atomic publication with rollback on validation failure.

nodes.label: Non-Executing Legacy Migration
nodes.rationale: Quarantine of unarmed legacy PR check scripts without execution; rebuild only canonically registered polls. Prevents execution of unverified script content.

nodes.label: PR Merge Meta Recording
nodes.rationale: fm-pr-merge.sh records pr= and pr_head= into task meta before merging so teardown's landed-check has a PR reference, even on repos with no PR CI.

nodes.label: PR URL Parsing for gh-axi
nodes.rationale: GitHub PR URL parsed to number + --repo arguments for gh-axi. Malformed URLs, unsafe segments, and repo overrides fail fast without calling gh-axi.

nodes.label: PR Merge Refusal Patterns
nodes.rationale: Merge refused before gh-axi when: task meta missing, malformed URL, unsafe URL segments, repo override flags. Merge failure propagates after meta recording.

nodes.label: PR Head Resolution in Review Diff
nodes.rationale: Review diff resolves the authoritative PR head (from pr_head= meta or refs/pull/<n>/head fetch) instead of stale local branch. Falls back with warning when PR head unreachable.
nodes.norm_label: pr head resolution in review diff

nodes.label: Secondmate Harness Split
nodes.rationale: config/secondmate-harness sets the harness the PRIMARY uses to launch SECONDMATE agents, independent of config/crew-harness (crewmate harness). Fallback chain: secondmate-harness -> crew-harness -> own.

nodes.label: Config Inheritance Primary to Secondmate
nodes.rationale: Primary pushes declared LOCAL config items - crew-dispatch.json, crew-harness, backlog-backend - into secondmate homes. config/secondmate-harness deliberately NOT inherited (secondmates don't spawn secondmates).

nodes.label: Secondmate Model/Effort Pin
nodes.rationale: config/secondmate-harness carries optional model and effort tokens after the harness. fm-spawn populates MODEL/EFFORT for --secondmate spawns only when harness resolves from that file.

nodes.label: Secondmate Lifecycle E2E Flow
nodes.rationale: Happy-path secondmate operator flow: seed -> spawn -> routed send -> backlog handoff -> recovery respawn -> teardown. Each phase asserts durable contracts.

nodes.label: Secondmate Seed Contracts
nodes.rationale: Registry line records scope from filled charter brief and project list. Charter copied into subhome. Remote-backed projects cloned with origin URL preserved. No-mistakes projects initialized in NEW subhome clone only.

nodes.label: Secondmate Spawn Contracts
nodes.rationale: Spawn meta records kind=secondmate, home=, and project list. Launch runs in the subhome with persistent charter and cleared operational overrides.

nodes.label: Secondmate Teardown Contracts
nodes.rationale: Teardown removes meta and registry route only after removing the home. Parent projects untouched. No main-backlog completion reminder emitted for secondmate teardown.

nodes.label: Agent Alive Probe
nodes.rationale: fm_backend_tmux_agent_alive classifies verified-harness foreground process as alive, bare shell as dead, ambiguous as unknown. fm_backend_herdr_agent_alive maps pane agent state.

nodes.label: Secondmate Liveness Sweep
nodes.rationale: bin/fm-bootstrap.sh secondmate_liveness_sweep: respawns confidently DEAD secondmate, keeps silent for ALIVE/DEAD results, never acts on UNKNOWN. Skipped under FM_BOOTSTRAP_DETECT_ONLY=1.

nodes.label: Liveness Convergence
nodes.rationale: Sweep converges: a live secondmate is never re-touched on later run (idempotent by construction). Naturally scoped to primary via kind=secondmate meta.

nodes.label: Secondmate Path Boundary
nodes.rationale: Path-boundary matrices for seed/spawn/teardown operations. Registry/charter/origin validation, treehouse lease handling, and child-worktree protection.

nodes.label: Registry Delimiter Path Refusal
nodes.rationale: Home seeding refuses home paths containing registry delimiters. No marker written, no registry route created on delimiter refusal.

nodes.label: Active Home Boundary Refusal
nodes.rationale: Secondmate home cannot be: the active FM_HOME, inside active FM_HOME, an ancestor of active FM_HOME, or the FM_ROOT (firstmate repo). Each with specific error message.

nodes.label: Local-HEAD Fast-Forward Sync
nodes.rationale: Shared ff helper advances behind home (updated), no-op on current, refuses on dirty/diverged/in-flight. No origin fetch in local sync. Marker tolerance allows gitignored marker without false dirty read.

nodes.label: Reread Nudge on Instruction Change
nodes.rationale: Bootstrap sweep sends reread nudge only when tracked instruction surface actually changed. Successful send: BOOTSTRAP_INFO, failed send: NUDGE_SECONDMATES.

nodes.label: Seed Marker Gitignore
nodes.rationale: .fm-secondmate-home marker gitignored so seeded homes don't read as dirty. Marker tolerance in ff-lib allows existing homes with untracked marker to fast-forward past gitignore fix commit.

nodes.label: Popup Settle Timing
nodes.rationale: Pre-submit popup settle timing: /... = 1.2s universal, $... to codex = 1.2s, $... to claude = 0.3s, plain text = 0.3s.

nodes.label: From-Firstmate Marker Protocol
nodes.rationale: Secondmate targets get FM_FROMFIRST_MARK prepended: '[fm-from-firstmate]' + U+2063 INVISIBLE SEPARATOR. Crewmates, explicit endpoints, --key remain unmarked. Transformation is idempotent.

nodes.label: Post-Submit Settle Pause
nodes.rationale: FM_SEND_SETTLE controls post-submit settle pause (default 1s). Zero disables. Tunable via env var. --key path never pauses.

nodes.label: Strict Target Resolution
nodes.rationale: Strict resolution: unset FM_HOME fails, unresolvable selectors do not tmux-fallback, prefixless herdr pane ids rejected, dead explicit endpoints fail.

nodes.label: Session Start Lock Refusal Path
nodes.rationale: Read-only lock refusal path: banner leads, every mutating step skipped (five bootstrap sweeps absent), digest still completes.

nodes.label: Session Start Context Digest
nodes.rationale: Absent-file markers versus empty-but-present files in context digest. Output section ordering: diagnostics/banners lead, bulk file dumps follow. Status-tail bounding via FM_SESSION_START_STATUS_TAIL.

nodes.label: Pi Extension Loaded Diagnostics
nodes.rationale: Session start validates Pi extension loaded markers: rejects stale markers, rejects missing turnend-guard markers, rejects previous-session loaded markers, accepts pre-lock loaded markers from current session.

nodes.label: Shared Captain Preference Propagation
nodes.rationale: Primary-authoritative shared captain-preference inheritance. Main home data/captain-shared.md pushed to secondmate homes as read-only. captain.md and learnings.md remain domain-local in every home.

nodes.label: Shared Captain Read-Only Enforcement
nodes.rationale: Shared captain file in secondmate homes set to read-only mode (FM_SHARED_CAPTAIN_MODE). Ordinary write attempts fail.

nodes.label: Shared Captain Drift Quarantine
nodes.rationale: When secondmate shared captain file drifts from primary, drift is quarantined and re-converged. Missing source mirrors absence. Convergence points: spawn, bootstrap, config-push.

nodes.label: Batch Dispatch
nodes.rationale: fm-spawn batch dispatch with id=repo pairs. Every pair dispatched even if first fails. projects/ paths scoped through FM_HOME, not caller cwd.

nodes.label: Dispatch Profile Selection
nodes.rationale: Concrete dispatch profile flags: harness/model/effort selection via crew-dispatch.json. Active profile requires explicit harness for ship/scout. Secondmate launches exempt.

nodes.label: Harness-Specific Profile Flags
nodes.rationale: Each harness receives specific flags: claude gets --model + --effort, codex gets --model + omits unsupported max effort, grok gets --model + --reasoning-effort, opencode gets --model + ignores effort axis, pi gets --model + --thinking.

nodes.label: Stow Inspect-Then-Update Contract
nodes.rationale: Inspect-then-update memory contract for /stow: task notes read first, replaced with recoverable archival (--archive-body), never append-first.

nodes.label: FM_HOME Parameterization
nodes.rationale: FM_HOME parameterizes data and state paths for all operations: brief scaffold, project mode, PR check, lock status. Multiple homes operate independently without state leakage.

nodes.label: Per-Home Lock Isolation
nodes.rationale: fm-lock status is scoped per home: lock files in one home state don't affect another home. Stale lock detection uses per-home PID files.

nodes.label: Child Worktree Protection
nodes.rationale: Parent project worktrees never mutated during secondmate operations. No write through a parent home.

nodes.label: No-Mistakes Init in New Clones Only
nodes.rationale: no-mistakes initialization (init + doctor) runs only in the NEW subhome clone, never in the parent project clone.
nodes.norm_label: no-mistakes init in new clones only

nodes.label: Endpoint Liveness Lines
nodes.rationale: Per-task endpoint-liveness lines in session start digest: one cheap alive/dead read per task, both tmux and herdr backends.

nodes.label: Supervision Block Output
nodes.rationale: Exactly one supervision block emitted per detected primary harness. Context-aware next-step guidance for normal watcher, AFK daemon, and X mode.

nodes.label: Stow Skill Task Note Contract
nodes.rationale: Stow skill requires: inspect before update (tasks-axi show --full), replace with --archive-body, never append-first.

nodes.label: AGENTS.md Backlog Note Contract
nodes.rationale: AGENTS.md keeps task-note hygiene inline: points exact mechanics (tasks-axi command syntax) to their owner, doesn't duplicate.

nodes.label: Marker Preserves Trailing Newlines
nodes.rationale: Marked secondmate send preserves trailing newline bytes in payload. Byte-level verification ensures no transformation damage.

nodes.label: handle_push_transition
nodes.rationale: Core watcher function tested for blocked-crew enqueue, pause absorption, dedupe marker safety, and secondmate window exclusion

nodes.label: event_wait_or_sleep
nodes.rationale: Watcher event-wait splice tested for secondmate exclusion, capability memoization, tmux-only inertness, and fail-closed disable

nodes.label: fm-supervision-instructions.sh
nodes.rationale: Harness-aware supervision instruction renderer for codex, claude, grok, pi, opencode harnesses; conditional stanzas, repair lines

nodes.label: fm_primary_tangle_branch
nodes.rationale: Tangle detection: non-empty for named non-default branch; empty for default, detached HEAD, or non-git

nodes.label: fm-teardown.sh
nodes.rationale: Teardown safety matrix: landed-work via fork-remote, squash-merge, content-fallback; stale index.lock recovery with lsof; transient retry

nodes.label: landed-work detection
nodes.rationale: Worktree safe-to-discard check: reachable from a remote, merged PR head, or content in default branch

nodes.label: stale index.lock recovery
nodes.rationale: Git index.lock recovery from killed crew: removes provably-stale, keeps when lsof fails or holder live, rechecks dirty

nodes.label: fm_transition_record
nodes.rationale: 5-field TAB-separated normalized transition record; scrubs TAB/newline; tolerates empty optionals

nodes.label: fm_transition_policy
nodes.rationale: Status-to-action table: blocked=actionable, working=absorb, idle/done=defer, else=fallback

nodes.label: fm_supervision_unhealthy
nodes.rationale: Supervision health: false with zero inflight, true with inflight+no/stale beacon, false with fresh beacon

nodes.label: fm-turnend-guard hook
nodes.rationale: Primary hook requiring PRIMARY checkout, live watcher lock, fresh beacon; Pi extension and Grok Stop hook integration

nodes.label: fm-update.sh
nodes.rationale: Fast-forward self-update: instruction surface detection, dirty/diverged/wrong-branch skipped, registry dedup

nodes.label: instruction surface detection
nodes.rationale: reread-firstmate yes only when AGENTS.md/bin/.agents/skills changed; README-only produces no

nodes.label: watcher+daemon lifecycle
nodes.rationale: End-to-end lifecycle: routine status handled, terminal caught on restart, drain routes to daemon, single flush, stale pane lifecycle

nodes.label: wake-queue safety matrix
nodes.rationale: Losslessness: concurrent append/drain, signal catch-up, stale enqueue ordering, atomic double-drain, duplicate collapse, liveness

nodes.label: fm-watch-checkpoint.sh
nodes.rationale: Bounded Codex foreground checkpoint: quiet timeout, signal passthrough, registered check env, singleton rejection

nodes.label: wake triage classifier
nodes.rationale: Always-on triage: absorbs working no-verb, surfaces stopped/terminal, stale threshold, afk coherence, paused secondmate re-surface

nodes.label: watcher lock/singleton safety
nodes.rationale: Invariants: singleton, stale lock reclaim, PID locale invariance, arm/attach/start/self-heal/fail-loud

nodes.label: fm_pid_identity
nodes.rationale: Locale-invariant PID identity via LC_ALL=C pinning across LC_ALL/LC_TIME variations

nodes.rationale: Watcher arm: attach, start+self-heal, HUP cleanup, immediate wake, peer beacon wait, fail-loud

nodes.rationale: Hermetic fake curl: /connector/poll, /connector/answer, /connector/followup, /connector/dismiss, /connector/request-context

nodes.rationale: Owner of herdr isolation, refuse-default, teardown, fleet-state tripwire contract

nodes.rationale: assert_contains/not_contains, expect_code, assert_grep/no_grep, assert_absent/present, fail/pass, fakebin
